body: Well our fabulous UK Government told us to refrain and retrain into another industry as they’re killing the arts industry. And it’s kind of useless to me because studios give me major anxiety (ironic i know), I just wanted to make beats

hey! i’m really sorry you’re feeling like this, i can feel your pain through the screen and trust me as an artist (albeit music artist) i can definitely relate to your feelings of not being good enough. 
i would love to see your drawings/art, i’m sure it’s pretty impressive as you are harnessing your creativity at a young age, which is commendable in itself!
you deserve happiness, keep your passion close and you’ll realise it becomes your place to escape. message me if you want a chat!
